scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Moving time-step/feedback references, qualified Newton initial guesses and original ground-supported input/prefix mechanics

temporal_audit.scope: Audit common-time full-arm contact fields with one unchanged closed initial state.
temporal_audit.limitations: All steps retain complete original1e-9 body/joint/fresh-step budgets, common closure arrays and identical declared initial velocities. This tests the short hold at one coarse fixed-polyhedron/contact setting. It does not establish original approach/lift/support-history matching, spatial/contact/regularization convergence, resolved-load/native feedback separation or a physical accuracy/cost range.

moving_feedback_audit.scope: Independently audit matched rigid/deformable holds and replay their resolved body loads.
moving_feedback_audit.limitations: The same geometry/control/contact/mass with rigid versus deformable body motion isolates feedback within the declared short held-initializer protocol. Initial equilibria are solved separately under the same supports/targets, not artificially forced to have identical loads. Linear full-inertia replay separates resolved-load changes from nonlinear constitutive effects. Native recovery, finite-footprint mapping, original approach/angular history, spatial/contact/regularization tails and physical accuracy/cost remain unverified here.

all_original_states.scope: Compare every accepted original state with the corresponding wide-coordinate history.
all_original_states.limitations: Every saved original accepted state, all original array fields and full corner/quadrature tensors are compared. Original incomplete histories remain incomplete. Independent complete force audits are separate requirements. Rounding diagnostics quantify observable arithmetic; they do not establish physical spatial/contact accuracy or original-history matching.

complete_middle_equivalence.scope: Compare every accepted original state with the corresponding wide-coordinate history.
complete_middle_equivalence.limitations: Every saved original accepted state, all original array fields and full corner/quadrature tensors are compared. Original incomplete histories remain incomplete. Independent complete force audits are separate requirements. Rounding diagnostics quantify observable arithmetic; they do not establish physical spatial/contact accuracy or original-history matching.

initial_motion_sensitivity.scope: Measure initial-motion sensitivity at identical solved closures and physical controls.
initial_motion_sensitivity.limitations: This isolates declared initial-velocity sensitivity at array-identical solved closures, fixed physical controls and one coarse spatial/contact setting. It does not match original approach/lift/support history or qualify physical spatial/contact accuracy. Original body/joint/fresh-step gates are established by the input independent audits; comparisons do not relax them.

native_replay.scope: Replay independently audited rigid/deformable body loads through actual native recovery.
native_replay.limitations: Actual native nodal replay isolates elastic algebra and compares full-inertia versus rigid-relief inputs at declared sampled times. It does not qualify finite-footprint mapping, contact/spatial/regularization convergence, original approach/angular history or physically verified warmed cost. Rigid/deformable feedback comes from independently solved corresponding contact histories, not native algebra agreement.

original_prefix_audit.scope: Independently reconstruct original-prefix controls, ground contact and full dynamic balances.
original_prefix_audit.limitations: This checks only the declared original-history prefix, with real ground support and original controls. Complete grasp/lift, spatial/contact/geometry/time convergence, matching rigid feedback and native model/accuracy-cost acceptance remain incomplete. Source native contacts are preintegration while macro states are postintegration; reported same-macro state differences are physical diagnostics, not contact-law equivalence.

original_robot_state_recovery.scope: Recover an original-prefix state using the actual independent robot step as residual.

dependency_corrections.reason: Extended-force producer715190_0 naturally fails at step59 after58 accepted saved states. Its incomplete result cannot feed complete80-step audits. Live wide-coordinate and physical spatial producers are preserved.

retained_failures: Extended-force-only run rejects step59 after58 accepted states.
Level15 spatial run rejects step26 above its unchanged1e-9N budget.
Feedback v1 fails JSON serialization after physical checks; v2 converts report scalars and retains raw NPZ fields.
Initial-motion v1 uses incompatible linear/nonlinear quadrature weights; v2 uses the pinned nonlinear quadrature.
Original prefix v1 fails its actual robot-step gate at step3; actual-response Newton v2 completes the declared80-step prefix.
Original robot-state v1 startup rejects an undeclared copied MJCF argument; v2 pins and verifies the copied MJCF.

limitations: Moving0.1s holds and the original0.1s ground-supported prefix pass scoped independent gates. The original3.3s approach/grasp/lift remains separate unverified work. Physical spatial/contact/geometry tails, complete history, remaining load-model sensitivity, feedback operating ranges and verified warmed accuracy/cost remain incomplete. Exact scientific and startup failures are retained; no force gate is relaxed. Newton-count observations are reference-only and are not native warmed cost claims. Only terminal cases are published. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
